description: Editor status bar footer showing save and dirty state, a save message with optional retry, the last-saved time, runtime recovery messages, and document metrics such as word count, page count, active region, and zoom. Phase 7: "Page X of Y" (CurrentPage / PageCount), plural word count, and - when OnZoomChanged / OnToggleFullscreen are bound - zoom minus / value / plus (the steps snap to the grid of 10 within ZoomMin..ZoomMax, so a fitted 62 percent goes to 70 / 60) and the fullscreen switch. The zoom value is a menu button: Automatic (ShowAutomaticZoom, checked for ZoomAutoFit narrow), Page width, Whole page and the round percents; its accessible name is ZoomAriaLabel.

parameters.name: ModeLabel
parameters.description: Names the mode the editor is in instead of the region being edited (the print preview: "Print preview"). Empty keeps "Editing {region}".

parameters.name: ShowZoom
parameters.description: Whether the zoom control (or label) is shown. A mode that has a zoom of its own, like the print preview, hides this one.

parameters.name: IsDirty
parameters.description: Whether the document has local unsaved changes.

parameters.name: ActiveRegionLabel
parameters.description: Label for the active editing region.

parameters.name: CanRetrySave
parameters.description: Whether the latest save failure can be retried.

parameters.name: LastSavedAt
parameters.description: Timestamp of the latest successful save.

parameters.name: OnRetrySave
parameters.description: Raised when the user requests retry after a recoverable save failure.

parameters.name: PageCount
parameters.description: Current document page count.

parameters.name: PendingCount
parameters.description: Number of currently pending async operations.

parameters.name: PendingMessage
parameters.description: Message of the first pending operation, or null when none.

parameters.name: RuntimeFailed
parameters.description: When true, RuntimeMessage describes a recovery failure.

parameters.name: RuntimeMessage
parameters.description: Message shown after a JS runtime recovery event, or null when none.

parameters.name: SaveMessage
parameters.description: Optional save status message.

parameters.name: WordCount
parameters.description: Current document word count.

parameters.name: ZoomLabel
parameters.description: Current zoom label.

parameters.name: ShowLastSaved
parameters.description: Whether the last-saved text is shown here. Defaults to true; the editor passes false while its header is visible, because the header owns the save state then and the same text must not render twice.

parameters.name: CurrentPage
parameters.description: The page the reader is on, one-based ("Page 2 of 6").

parameters.name: IsFullscreen
parameters.description: Whether the editor is in fullscreen (the switch is pressed).

parameters.name: OnToggleFullscreen
parameters.description: Raised when the fullscreen switch is pressed. The switch renders only when it is bound.

parameters.name: OnZoomChanged
parameters.description: Raised with the new zoom percent when the reader presses minus / plus. The controls render only when it is bound.

parameters.name: ZoomMax
parameters.description: The highest zoom the buttons reach, in percent. Defaults to the editor's own ceiling, 200.

parameters.name: ZoomMin
parameters.description: The lowest zoom the buttons reach, in percent. Defaults to the editor's own floor, 50.

parameters.name: ZoomPercent
parameters.description: The zoom in percent; the minus / plus buttons step from it and disable at ZoomMin / ZoomMax.

parameters.name: ZoomStep
parameters.description: How far one press of minus / plus moves the zoom, in percent. Defaults to 10.

parameters.name: ZoomPreset
parameters.description: The zoom preset the engine reports: custom, fitWidth or fitPage. Marks the checked entry of the zoom menu.

parameters.name: ZoomAutoFit
parameters.description: The automatic-fit state the engine reports: off (the reader's zoom), narrow (Automatic) or always (Page width).

parameters.name: ShowAutomaticZoom
parameters.description: Whether the "Automatic" entry of the zoom menu is offered; the editor hides it while its page fit mode is not Auto.

parameters.name: ZoomAriaLabel
parameters.description: The accessible name of the zoom value; a fitted page names the fit ("Zoom 62 percent, fitted to width"). Null derives it from ZoomLabel.

parameters.name: OnZoomAutomatic
parameters.description: Raised when "Automatic" is chosen in the zoom menu: back to the editor's configured automatic fit.

parameters.name: OnZoomPageWidth
parameters.description: Raised when "Page width" is chosen in the zoom menu: the page follows the column from now on.

parameters.name: OnZoomWholePage
parameters.description: Raised when "Whole page" is chosen in the zoom menu: the whole page fits the document region.
